feature: Recorded habitat chapters, real generation visits and chapter population comparison
behavior: Group consecutive actual survival rounds by recorded habitat and trait-selection setting, keeping the arrival snapshot separate.
Show the population immediately before the first round, the final offspring cohort, actual trait means and every round’s parent/survivor/offspring counts.
Browse chapters through selectable habitat cards, arrow keys, Home/End and previous/next controls.
Visit any chapter generation on the actual island, including its preceding population, with the correct recorded habitat.
Open population comparison with the chapter’s exact before-and-after generations rather than the default founder-to-current pair.
Preserve draft survival predictions while reading, comparing and saving; visiting another generation waits until the draft is finished or cancelled.
Save livingIslandHabitatTrail evidence separately from personal explanations, forecasts and population comparisons.

modelChecks: Chronological chapter coverage, selection changes without habitat changes, queued settings excluded and exact baseline/final boundaries.
Means read from actual inherited genes rather than cached statistics; genes, world history and future replay unchanged.
Valid zero mean versus undefined empty-population mean; one survivor does not imply an offspring cohort.
Arrival without survival rounds, full 60-round history and malformed or sparse history guards.
browserEvidence: Real 3D desktop: archived habitat despite queued future settings, visible focused entry, keyboard chapter choices, exact counts and means, actual baseline island visit, G2-to-G4 comparison, separate notes and one renderer.

Phone with reduced motion: draft estimate retained through reading and exact chapter comparison, history visits disabled during the draft, zero WCAG A/AA/2.1 AA violations in the trail and no horizontal overflow.
WebGL fallback extinction: zero-valued inherited trait, one survivor, no offspring and undefined after-chapter mean/difference; correct G0-to-G1 comparison.
validation.reviewedSnapshotScope: Only the two Evolution Lab entries changed. The optional trail leaves default button, input and SVG counts unchanged.
refinements: Added phone focus clearance below sticky controls and constrained the trail’s inner grid width.
Used the existing empty-mean display in the extinction assertion; absence remains a dash, not zero.

evidenceLimits: Chapters describe recorded conditions and changes in different populations. They do not isolate a causal effect of habitat or selection. Selection, chance, inheritance and mutation can contribute; individuals retain their original genes. Queued future settings are excluded.
